description: For each outlet with 30+ radar headlines and 7+ days of history: its hour-of-week pattern (UTC) over 30 days, the number of headlines it usually gives in the same 6 hours of the week, and what came in the last 6 hours. suspicious_silence = none while 3+ were usual. In honour of Julius Shiskin (1912-1978), author of the X-11 seasonal adjustment. Rule-based, no AI.
name: get_shiskin
title: Shiskin sensor: is a silent outlet broken, or is this its usual quiet hour
